recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If FHIR-I wants * to become a formal terminology concept, raise that as a new design/terminology issue instead of inferring it from this old data-types binding correction.
issue_request: FHIR-8594 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and reported that ElementDefinition.type.code was bound to the data-types value set even though FHIR StructureDefinitions used resource names plus the special xhtml and * type-code cases.
initial_application: Commit 0c3f6c7312134abd6957687e714ffcdab61a9f2e, the git-svn r6371 application mentioned in Jira, changed ElementDefinition.type.code from the old DataType binding to FHIRDefinedType and fixed validator/type fallout.
additional_context: Later decisions changed the same area: FHIR-12245 made ElementDefinition.type.code a uri for logical models, FHIR-35853 introduced FHIRPathTypes and an ElementDefinition-specific value set, FHIR-32069 renamed/reorganized the current type value set sources, and FHIR-22670 clarified extensible binding handling for string/uri/code special cases.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active ElementDefinition source is still in build scope, ElementDefinition.type.code is currently a uri bound extensibly to ElementDefinitionTypes, that value set imports FHIRPath types plus all FHIR types, the generated fhir-types surface includes resource types and xhtml, and the remaining * value is already documented as the open-type wildcard rather than a normal generated FHIR type concept.

related_jiras.note: Changed ElementDefinition.type.code from code to uri and clarified relative/absolute StructureDefinition references for logical models.
Introduced the ElementDefinition-specific value set that includes FHIRPath and FHIR type codes used by the core spec.
Reorganized/renamed type value set sources, leaving the current binding as ElementDefinitionTypes.
Clarified extensible binding behavior for string/uri/code and compiler-magic ElementDefinition type codes.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue reported ElementDefinition.type.code values outside the then data-types binding, including resources, xhtml, and *.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the original final request and the values that needed to be accounted for.

evidence_items.learned: The issue was historically applied, and the old data-types binding was intentionally replaced.

evidence_items.summary: The current build-scope ElementDefinition.type.code row is uri and uses the extensible ElementDefinitionTypes binding.
evidence_items.learned: The current source no longer has the problematic data-types binding from FHIR-8594.

evidence_items.summary: ElementDefinitionTypes imports the FHIRPath type code system and ValueSet/fhir-types.
evidence_items.learned: The current value set is specifically broader than data-types and covers FHIRPath and FHIR type codes.

evidence_items.summary: The datatypes page documents * as the open-type wildcard and lists open-type usage.
evidence_items.learned: The wildcard is treated as documented special syntax, not as a normal generated FHIR type concept.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 issue introduced FHIRPathTypes and a new ElementDefinition-specific value set for ElementDefinition.type.code.
evidence_items.learned: Later WG intent explains why the current binding is ElementDefinitionTypes and not the old FHIRDefinedType/DataType binding.

evidence_items.summary: The current generated terminology imports fhir-types, whose generated code system includes Resource, DomainResource, concrete resources, and xhtml.
evidence_items.learned: The generated specification surface includes the non-wildcard codes that were missing from the original data-types binding.
